description:
*“How did I end up doing a strip show in front of a classmate I barely even know?”*

Baek Han-Yeong has lived his whole life as a perfectly ordinary No-Namer, someone without the fated mark of destiny. That is, until he gets to college and meets Ryu Cheong-Hyeon, a bold Namer with the name “Baek Han-yeong” etched right across his neck. Cheong-Hyeon, convinced fate is at play, starts tailing Han-Yeong everywhere, fascinated by the uncanny coincidence. Exhausted and desperate to prove he’s just a plain old No-Namer, Han-Yeong blurts out the wildest challenge imaginable… and ends up undressing right in front of him. Regret hits immediately. 

 *“If I could go back in time, I’d never throw out a stupid suggestion like that to this lunatic…”*

But now that the line’s been crossed, will fate keep dragging them back together, or was this one outrageous mistake just the beginning?

(Source: Lezhin US)
